description.value: Up the Creek Backpacker's Lodge is a family-run cedar house hostel on BC's Sunshine Coast, operating since 2004 and situated 14 km from the Langdale ferry terminal — making it a natural stopover for cyclists arriving by BC Ferries from Vancouver. It explicitly caters to cyclists with loaner bikes and a dedicated cyclist camping area, and sits a short 10-minute walk from the heart of Roberts Creek village. The lodge has a warm, nature-focused character and is well-reviewed for cleanliness and hospitality.

address.value: 1261 Roberts Creek Road, Roberts Creek, V0N 2W2
